title: Be glad my soul and glorify the lord (Magnificat)
content:
Be glad my soul and glorify the lord;
my spirit finds its joy in God, my saviour.

For he smiled down upon my littleness;
henceforth all men shall call me “ever blessed”.

It was he, the mighty Lord, the Holy one,
who wrought in me the marvel of his power.

To those who fear and love his holy name
from age to age he shows his tender mercy.

Conceited, haughty men he drives astray
his strong right arm has swept away their folly.

Earth’s mighty ones he topples from their thrones;
near to himself he sets the meek and the lowly.

Lo, from his feast he turns away the proud,
while with choice food he feeds his trustful children.

How safe he keeps his people, Israel
bearing in mind the promise of his mercy.

Which once he swore to Abraham of old
and to his seeds to us for evermore.

Father, Son and Holy Spirit one in three,
all praise be yours, O blessed Trinity.
